_doc: The feature properties that the page's dashboard modules and page scripts read (docs/reference/contract.md, 'What a page reads'). pieces: a feature of a drawn layer (the road pieces, the items, the decks and shadows, the slots of the inline arrows). table: a row of the road table (also the fields of roadstyle:interaction's popup and tooltip, every public field when the popup list is null, the edge_id_col, and the road's line). The layers' own expressions read what they read (props::reads collects it). tests/test_contract_names.py fails when a module reads a __rs_* property that is not here.
